voice.speaker: odysseus
voice.caption: Cyclops! It was no weak man's friends you ate in your hollow cave — your evil deeds were bound to find you out! You dared devour guests in your own house, and Zeus and the gods have paid you for it!
Polyphemus tears off a mountain peak and hurls it, driving a wave that nearly beaches the ship again.

voice.speaker: odysseus
voice.caption: Cyclops — if any mortal ever asks who put out your eye so shamefully, tell him this: it was Odysseus, sacker of cities, who blinded you — Laertes's son, whose home is in Ithaca!

So the old prophecy comes home — Telemus foretold I would lose my sight at the hands of Odysseus, and I watched all these years for a great man, not this little worthless nothing who undid me with wine. Hear me, Poseidon, dark-haired shaker of the earth, if I am truly your son: grant that Odysseus, sacker of cities, never reach his home. Or if he must, let him come late and broken, on a stranger's ship, all his comrades lost — and find trouble waiting in his house.
A second rock misses as the ship escapes to the fleet.

keys.beat: From offshore Odysseus taunts the blinded Cyclops despite his men's pleas.
Polyphemus tears off a mountain peak and hurls it, driving a wave that nearly beaches the ship again.
Odysseus rows farther out, then reveals his true name and lineage.
Polyphemus recalls a prophecy, calls on Poseidon, and asks that Odysseus return late, alone, and in pain.
A second rock misses as the ship escapes to the fleet.
